title: Riemannian Geometry

syllabus.details: Definition and examples of Riemannian metrics,examples of RIemannian manifolds with special focus on graphs, level sets and surfaces, Model Riemannian manifolds.
Geodesics, Completeness and the Hopf–Rinow theorem, first and second variational formula.
Connections,, Geodesics, Parallel Transport,Levi-Civita Connection, Exponential map, Tubular Neighborhoods.
The curvature tensor, Ricci and Scalar curvature,sectional curvature, The second fundamental form,hypersurfaces.
Jacobi fields, Hessians and Riccati equation, Comparison theory, Curvature and Topology, Cartan–Hadamard theorem, Global results of Riemannian geometry like the Bonnet–Myers theorem
